recommended_next_phase: Not real FIDO2 enrollment. Recommend a phase scoped to exactly two narrow, independent prerequisite-repair actions: (1) provision the fido2 Python package (and any transitive HID/CTAP dependency) into the deployed venv on hac-dell under governed infrastructure-change discipline, and (2) physically attach and re-verify exactly one eligible FIDO2 authenticator via the same read-only inspection method used here. Only after both are independently reconfirmed fresh may a future phase attempt real HardwareCredential enrollment -- never combined with Principal/Signer/DeploymentBinding/HATP activation in that same phase.
summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N re-derived the remaining post-HMIC-v1.7 Trust-Enrollment DAG from current production source (never from a prior phase's report alone) and independently re-confirmed, via fresh read-only SSH inspection of hac-dell run under the correct privilege context for each check (root for Protected-Root-owned certification files, the canonical pcae OS principal for the Class-B diagnostic): the deployed revision is unchanged and clean (4efcb255ca5340224f0278f724b939d794a553ca); a fresh call to validate_active_hatp_mandatory_independent_verification_certification returns VALID for the active v1.7/38 certification (de110d41...); the canonical Class-B verifier returns NON_COMPLIANT with the sole expected residual HBDC-REQ-042 (DeploymentBinding absent); all eight HATP activation readiness terms were individually enumerated (six True, two False -- hatp_substrate_operational and class_b_deployment_conformance_satisfies_readiness, both confirmed strictly downstream of the same missing HardwareCredential -> Principal/Signer -> DeploymentBinding chain, not independent blockers); and /etc/pcae/hatp/ contains only the trust-store's three protected files -- no HardwareCredentialRecord, Principal, Signer, or DeploymentBinding exists anywhere. Performed only non-enrolling, read-only FIDO2 availability inspection: lsusb (standard USB topology enumeration) shows no known FIDO2/security-key-class device on hac-dell's USB bus (only a webcam, Bluetooth adapter, a Broadcom general-purpose secure-applications processor, and a touchscreen); separately, attempting to import pcae.core.hatp_fido2_provider on the deployed venv raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fido2' at its module-level import -- the fido2 Python package is not installed in the deployed venv at all, so the FIDO2 provider cannot even reach device enumeration. No makeCredential call, no CTAP/HID session, and no user-presence prompt occurred at any point -- both inspections are read-only by construction. Independently reconstructed from current source (scripts/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py, src/pcae/core/hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py, hatp_principal_signer_admin.py, hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py): the CLI's public surface is exactly {enroll, revoke} (no recover/import/restore); a load-bearing sequencing finding that the real hardware ceremony runs in _cmd_enroll BEFORE the interactive confirmation/--assume-yes gate is even constructed, meaning Protected Admin authorization for the physical touch must be established before the command is ever invoked, not enforced by the runtime prompt; zero-device raises HATPProviderUnavailableError while multiple devices deterministically select devices[0] with no contract-defined disambiguation (a documented, non-blocking-for-now gap since zero devices, not multiple, is the actual current state); register_credential is idempotent-or-fails-closed on any existing record, never overwrites; the bounded in-process persistence retry (NB-2L.4-1) remains purely Non-Blocking, unchanged by this phase's findings; the orphaned-credential terminal state fails closed with an explicit diagnostic and no manual-import path exists; FIDO2 credential parameters are RP id hatp.pcae.local, ES256-only, no explicit resident-key/user-verification option, no PIN handling anywhere in the code path; and Model B (registry resolves governance identity, hardware proves possession and signs, via HATPTrustStore.resolve_deployment_authorization in hatp_signing_ceremony.py's _resolve_signer) remains the enforced production signing design. Selected verdict per the phase's own decision procedure: B/D -- NO USABLE FIDO2 AUTHENTICATOR PRESENT, compounded by the fido2 Python package being absent from the deployed venv -- REAL FIDO2 ENROLLMENT BLOCKED. Rejected alternative A (selecting FIDO2 enrollment and freezing a one-credential authorization envelope) because two independent prerequisites fail; freezing an envelope now would manufacture readiness that does not exist, explicitly forbidden. No authorization envelope is frozen. Recorded a new Non-Blocking finding, NB-2N-1: no single OS principal can correctly observe all eight readiness terms in one process invocation of assess_hatp_mandatory_activation_readiness() (root context corrupts the Class-B term via agent/admin-OS-principal collision; the canonical pcae identity cannot read root-owned certification files) -- a usability/observability gap, not an authority-bearing defect, not repaired here. NB-2L.4-1 re-confirmed still purely Non-Blocking. No production source (src/pcae/core/**, scripts/**, docs/contracts/**) was modified -- only this report, its own new test file, and task/status/metadata bookkeeping. Fast Green (python -m pytest -m fast_green, full non-tail-truncated, single run): raw baseline counts of 335 pre-existing failed nodes, 8592 passed, 4 skipped, 27041 deselected, 9 pre-existing errors -- matching, in kind and magnitude and in exact literal count, 149O.20L.7O.2M.4's own recorded post-change baseline of 335 pre-existing failed nodes, 8592 passed, 4 skipped, 9 pre-existing errors, exactly. This phase's own new 16-test file (15 passing, 1 conditionally skipped pre-finalization) independently confirmed passing in isolation, contributing zero failing nodes. Zero attributable source/logic regressions. Recommends the narrowest next prerequisite phase be dependency provisioning (fido2 package) plus physical authenticator attachment/re-verification, not real FIDO2 enrollment.
